description: Eight channel voltage controlled CV mixer, with each channel put out on its own and all eight put out as a mix

params.text: Attenuates the modulation input for its channel, 0 to 100%
Scales the mix from silence to full, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: One of the eight inputs, polyphonic, scaled by its own knob and its own modulation
Adds to the level of its channel, 10V shifting the level by a full 100% when the knob beside it is fully up

outputs.text: Its channel on its own, after the level knob and the modulation for that channel
The eight scaled channels added together and scaled by the Mix knob
